policy: Connect only official public APIs, open datasets, or sources for which DealHunter has explicit permission. A catalogue entry is not proof that the source has been integrated.

sources.name: GSA Auctions
sources.notes: Existing DealHunter connector. Public federal surplus assets and auctions; verify current bid, reserve, condition and auction status.

sources.name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily
sources.notes: Connecteur officiel TED v3 intégré ; avis publics collectés automatiquement tous les deux jours et affichés comme signaux acheteurs non vérifiés.

sources.name: SAM.gov Get Opportunities
sources.notes: Connecteur officiel SAM.gov intégré ; collecte automatique tous les deux jours via le secret GitHub SAM_API_KEY. Avis publics = signaux de demande non confirmés.

sources.name: Open Contracting Data Registry
sources.notes: Catalogue of public contracting datasets from 100+ publishers. Each publisher has its own coverage, format, licence and update schedule.

sources.name: World Bank Procurement Notices
sources.notes: Public notices for World Bank-financed projects. Procurement demand signals, not seller inventory.

sources.name: EU Public Procurement Data Space
sources.notes: Discovery and reuse of EU and national public procurement data; identify underlying datasets before integrating to avoid duplicate notices.
